title: Popular, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-08
summary: Popular, Inc. filed an 8-K on April 8, 2026 announcing two executive appointments effective July 1, 2026: Manuel A. Chinea as Executive Vice President and Chief Experience and Administration Services Officer, and Israel Velasco as Executive Vice President and Head of U.S. Operations of Popular Bank.
key_points: Manuel A. Chinea, current COO of Popular Bank since February 2013, will assume responsibility for customer experience, human resources, corporate real estate, and marketing functions
Israel Velasco, currently Senior Vice President and Florida Region Executive since June 2005, will succeed Mr. Chinea as Head of U.S. Operations
Popular, Inc. is a bank holding company based in Puerto Rico (ticker: BPOP on NASDAQ)
